audit.whatIsWrong: Rows 0-5 read Skill, Sion, Sion, Skill, Skill, Sion while every matching why says the stage is yours ('You dominate from level 1', 'The lane is yours wire-to-wire').
audit.why: packet.levelChart gives Volibear all six of those rows on a 52.42% lane, and the prose agrees. The page was rendering the opposite of its own argument.
audit.corrected: Rows 0-5 set to Volibear in both layers, ratings raised to match. Row 6 left alone — packet says Sion, the mirror audit set it to Skill, and I would not guess between them.

audit.why: Spike shape is right: your 3-6 window, your first item, then Sion outscaling into teamfights on Unstoppable Onslaught (140/100/60s) and Glory in Death.

audit.whatIsWrong: Roar of the Slayer was never mentioned, and Soul Furnace was described only as 'his W shield'. Glory in Death's healing was absent despite the entry recommending Executioner's Calling.
audit.why: Roar of the Slayer is 12/11/10/9/8s at 800 range, slows AND reduces your armour, and knocks a minion back so it can pass through the wave to reach you — that is how he wins the poke war before you close. Soul Furnace is 15/14/13/12/11s and detonates on reactivation 3 seconds after the cast, which is a leave-now timer, not a shield to grind through. Glory in Death reanimates him with rapid attacks that heal him and deal max-health damage, which is what the anti-heal buy is actually for.
audit.corrected: All three written in with real numbers; the full-charge condition on Decimating Smash (10/9/8/7/6s) stated so you know a partial charge does not knock up.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'W bleed' used for Frenzied Maul in several fields.
audit.why: Frenzied Maul marks the target; the second cast deals bonus damage and heals Volibear. There is no bleed.
audit.corrected: Fixed where an in-band field allowed it.

edits.before: - Sion Decimating Smash (Stun): matchup-defining — Charged = knockup. Sidestep it. Track it before every engage. - Sion Decimating Smash: Charged swing; fully charged it knocks up in a big area. Dodge or sidestep it.
edits.after: - Sion Decimating Smash: 10s at rank 1, and only a full charge knocks up — step through an early release. - Sion Roar of the Slayer: 12s at 800 range, shreds your armour, and he can fire it through a minion to reach you.

edits.before: Charged = knockup. Sidestep it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Only a full charge knocks up — it is 10s at rank 1, so walk in early.

edits.before: Burning your answer for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Soul Furnace is 15s and detonates 3s after the cast — be gone by then.

edits.before: Charging Q into a waiting Decimating Smash (Stun) — losing the stun before you land it means you took the whole trade for nothing and your W mark expires un-cashed.
edits.after: Standing beside a dying Sion — Glory in Death reanimates him with rapid attacks that heal him and hit for max health, so step away and let it decay out.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 remain yours since his W shield can't survive your ramped autos and W bleed.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 remain yours since Soul Furnace is 15s and your double-bite heal outlasts it.

edits.before: Land a fully charged Q knock-up for a big trade
edits.after: Shred your armour with Roar of the Slayer first

notes: The entry asserts in five places that your Q stun 'interrupts' or 'cancels' Sion's charged Decimating Smash. Sion's kit text does not describe the charge as a channel and carries no channel flag, so I could not verify interrupt behaviour from the kits and left every one of those strings untouched. Row 6 is a three-way disagreement: packet says Sion, the mirror audit set it to Skill, the prose argues Sion.
